about:
# About Me

Visual artist, creator of intimate digital experiences.

Exploring memory, fragments, and the spaces between reality and perception.

*(Edit this file — `content/about.md` — to change this text. Markdown works: **bold**, headings, [links](https://example.com), images.)*

file.title: every file is a promise
file.body:
Every file is a promise:
that something once mattered
enough to be kept.

Somewhere on this disk
a folder waits the way photographs wait —
patiently, and without hope.

edit.title: undo
edit.body:
Undo. Undo. Undo.

If only memory shipped
with the same shortcut —
the kitchen, the argument, the door —
pressed once, gently.

view.title: arms length
view.body:
Zoom in far enough
and everything becomes abstraction:
pixels, grain, atoms, guesses.

Zoom out far enough
and it happens again.
Meaning lives only at arm's length.

go.title: go but never where
go.body:
The menu says Go,
but never where.

Back. Forward. Enclosing folder.
As if all journeys were rearrangements
of what already contains us.

window.title: a window on a screen
window.body:
A window on a screen
inside a window in a wall.

Both promise the same thing:
that the world continues past the frame,
and that you may watch it
without being seen.
